contentText:
On Monday evening, a long-distance train slammed into a stationary commuter train that had stopped after striking a vehicle at an unmonitored level crossing. All 15 victims were women.

🗣️ "I thought I was going to die. We were trapped, but thank God, I made it out. It feels like a dream," said survivor Sausan Sarifah.

Indonesia's president has ordered an investigation and called for tighter safety measures at level crossings.
